digest.component_or_area: codebase module-size management and CI gating
propositions: 46 files in src/rebar exceed 700 LOC with 7 files at or near the 800-LOC hard cap, creating recurrent headroom exhaustion as new code lands
pass1.py (800 LOC) and push.py (799 LOC) are split via pure relocation into container_stage.py and push_recovery.py respectively, both sized in [100–500] LOC band, reducing parent files to ≤550 LOC

Module-size CI gate emits non-blocking near-cap warnings listing all src/rebar files within 10% of the locked 800-LOC cap (i.e., ≥720 LOC), surfacing the pre-computed module_size_distribution.near_cap_count (currently 37) that was previously invisible

All re-exports from original modules (pass1.<symbol>, push.<symbol>) and test-count parity are preserved across changes 1 and 2; no test files are edited and no complexity-baseline entries are modified
Late-binding core: ModuleType pattern (from _ref_lock_push.py precedent) resolves push._git at call-time in extracted push_recovery functions to avoid monkeypatch cycles across ~25 test sites

_submit_ctx moves to generation.py (not container_stage.py) because the pool worker it launches calls generation.review_cancelled(), which reads generation-owned _CANCEL_SCOPE ContextVar via copy_context()
